title: Wealth Management Operations - Fund Processing Internship

titleByLocale.it: Operazioni di gestione della ricchezza - Stage di elaborazione fondi
titleByLocale.en: Wealth Management Operations - Fund Processing Internship
titleByLocale.de: Wealth Management Operations - Fund Processing Internship
titleByLocale.fr: Wealth Management Operations - Fund Processing Internship

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you detail-oriented and interested in financial markets and fund operations? Do you enjoy working with data and ensuring accuracy in processes? We’re looking for a Fund Processing Intern to:
• support daily fund processing activities, including validation of Net Asset Value (NAV), subscriptions, redemptions and reconciliations
• assist in monitoring and validating fund data, ensuring consistency and accuracy across systems
• identify and help investigate discrepancies, working with internal teams and external stakeholders when needed
• maintain and update internal control files and databases used for fund monitoring and reporting
• support the preparation of reports for internal stakeholders
• contribute to process improvements and automation initiatives using data analysis and programming tools
• help ensure processes are executed in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements
• participate in process reviews, identifying opportunities to increase efficiency and mitigate risks
